# theme-partials spec

**Feature**: Scriptlog "blog" theme - shared partials consistency
**Generated by**: Playwright Planner Agent (per `prompts/11-master-playwright-planner.md`)
**App**: Scriptlog, PHP >= 7.4, MVC, Bootstrap 4, jQuery
**Bootstrap**: use `e2e/seed.spec.ts` and `playwright.config.js`
**Phase**: Plan section 5.2 Phase 6 - "Shared partials"

---

## Purpose

Guarantee the shared post card (`partials/card.php`) and paginator
(`partials/paginator.php`) render byte-identical structure on every consumer template:
home latest-posts, blog listing, category, tag, and archive. No template may re-define
card markup, otherwise a later refactor drifts.

---

## URLs

| Route | Expected cards |
|-------|----------------|
| `/` | `.latest-posts` grid (>= 3) |
| `/blog` | `.posts-listing` (>= 1) |
| `/?cat=200` | `.posts-listing` (>= 1) |
| `/?tag=e2e-tag` | `.posts-listing` (>= 1) |
| `/?a=202608` | `.posts-listing` (>= 1) |

---

## Preconditions

- `blogware_e2e` has >= 8 published posts; topic 200 linked to >= 3; tag `e2e-tag` on
  >= 2; archive month 08/2026 with >= 2 posts.
- Active theme `blog`; rewrite disabled.

---

## User Actions

- Load each listing route and snapshot the card markup shape.
- Confirm each card contains the same child sequence: `.post-thumbnail` then
  `.post-details` with `.post-meta`, `h3.h4` link, `.text-muted` excerpt, `meta.php`
  block.
- Confirm the paginator renders the same classes (`page-link`, active state) when a listing
  exceeds the page size.

---

## Expected Behaviour

- All listing routes render cards with identical class names and nesting (the only
  difference is the `card_class` column wrapper).
- Card order matches the source query order (newest first where applicable).
- Paginator, when present, has `aria-label` and prev/next links; no duplicate paginators
  per page.

---

## Validation Rules

- For each route, assert `locator('.post .post-thumbnail')` count equals
  `locator('.post h3.h4')` count and both are >= 1.
- Assert every `.post` card contains exactly one `h3.h4` and one `.post-meta`.
- Assert exactly one `.pagination` (or none) per listing page.
- Optionally assert the inner HTML of two cards from different routes is identical after
  normalizing the title/date text.

---

## UI Components

- `partials/card.php`: `.post`, `.post-thumbnail`, `.post-details`, `h3.h4`, `.post-meta`,
  `meta.php`.
- `partials/paginator.php`: `.pagination`, `.page-item`, `.page-link`.
- Consumer templates: `home.php`, `blog.php`, `category.php`, `tag.php`, `archive.php`.

---

## Accessibility

- Pagination links have text or aria-labels; active page marked `aria-current`.
- Cards' title links have matching `title` attribute.

---

## Test Scenarios (prioritized)

Critical:
- Home, blog, category, tag, archive all render cards with the shared structure.
- Card thumbnail count == title count on every listing.

High:
- Paginator appears only once per page when the list is long.
- Card markup from different routes is structurally identical.

Regression:
- Identical assertions hold after partialization.

---

## Notes for the Generator Agent

Generate `e2e/theme-partials.spec.js`. Loop over the listing URLs, assert card counts and
structure, and count paginators. Run chromium/firefox/webkit.
